Enabled.Name: Enable Color Coding
Enabled.Hint: Color spells on character sheets by their school of magic.

OnlyPrepared.Name: Only Color Prepared Spells
OnlyPrepared.Hint: Leave unprepared spells uncolored. Cantrips and spells that do not need preparing are always colored.

AddBorder.Name: Include Left Border
AddBorder.Hint: Draw a solid border in the school color on the left edge of each spell.

Style.Name: Fill Style
Style.Hint: How the school color is drawn behind the spell.

Width.Name: Fill Length
Width.Hint: Whether the color covers only the spell name or the whole row.

Intensity.Name: Color Intensity
Intensity.Hint: How strong the fill color is, from 0 (invisible) to 100 (opaque).

Color.Hint: The color used for spells of this school.
